messages.en: What are you doing?
I just finished my schedule.
I ordered a margherita pizza.
It kept lingering in my head.
So I thought it was fate and ordered it.
But you were the only one on my mind.
Right?
Who's this Margherita guy?
There is one. Someone who looks good in red.
But it's only temporary.
Y/n is always there, right?
Hehe, are you jealous?
Getting jealous over something like Margherita...
Did you think
you meant something that insignificant to me?
I'm disappointed!
I forgot your nickname. Let me try again.
Did you think Y/n meant so little to me!?

messages.ko: 이름을 굳이 안써도 될만큼 내 머릿속엔 네이름만 떠다니니까!!!
messages.en: Your name is the only one floating around in my head, so I don't even have to say it!!!
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋㄹㄹㅋ
You've really mastered making excuses...
Haven't you mastered 'Re' yet?
I only made it up to 'Fa.'
Well, green onions do smell pretty strong.
I've been hit with green onions before.
How did that happen...?
Like getting slapped with green onion kimchi?
Wow, that sounds delicious. I'd eat it immediately.
If it's a green onion kimchi slap,
I'd actually be happy.
*Slurp.*
You should keep your mouth open with Jjapagetti in it.
I'd probably have been holding it in my mouth since two days ago.

messages.ko: 나는 석박지 젤 좋아하는데 석박지 싸대기..는 좀 무서울거같긴해
messages.en: Seokbakji is my favorite, but getting slapped with it sounds scary.
Probably about as hard as getting hit with a rock.
Today,
I filmed something I think Y/n will like.
It's a secret.
I just wanted to make you curious.
A little dopamine boost.
I really pushed myself.
I'm kind of a professional at that.
Now I overwork myself without even thinking about it.
I wasn't originally this kind of person~
I used to be a pure, delicate, innocent goddess.
How did this happen? ㅎㅎ
Oh right.

messages.ko: 최근에 언니들 없는 제니스 회식이 있었는데
messages.en: Recently, Zenith had a dinner together without the older members.
We even did an escape room.
While we were doing the escape room,
I think I solved about half of it.
I found clues and solved puzzles.
Everyone had very clear roles.

messages.ko: 연지는 밥먹을때 고기 구웠으니까 좀 쉬고싶었는지 리액션 담당 ㅎ
messages.en: Since Yeonji grilled the meat while we were eating, I guess she wanted a break, so she became the reaction manager. ㅎ
Joobin was the brain, figuring things out.
Whenever we figured something out, she'd go enter the answer.

messages.ko: 수민이는 여기저기 보면서 이거이니야? 이거아니야? 의견 제의 담당?
messages.en: Soomin kept looking around saying, 'Is it this? Or this?' She was basically in charge of throwing out ideas.

messages.ko: 난 행동대장 앞에 서서 문제 풀고 알려주고 문제의 의도를 정확히 간파하는.
messages.en: I was the action leader, solving puzzles at the front and figuring out exactly what each problem was asking.
But it's really comfortable being with the younger members.
They grill the meat for me.
They even set up the utensils.
They've learned well.
When I'm with the older members, that's usually my job.
So with this lineup,
I'm going to eat together with them a lot~

messages.ko: 주빈이가 귀엽고 연지가 재밌고 수민이가 말이 많아
messages.en: Joobin is cute, Yeonji is funny, and Soomin talks a lot.
Whenever it's noisy and everyone's talking nonstop, it's always Zenith.
I'll be in charge of beauty and visuals. ㅋ
Aren't you the comedy member?
I'll give that role to Yubin unnie, and Jiwoo unnie can be in charge of reactions.
Everyone's working hard at their role.
I hope the other members see this.
If anyone disagrees, I'm automatically right. ㅎ
The pizza arrived and I took one bite.
It's a wood-fired pizza, so chewy and just...
It's insane.
Didn't you order any sides?
Nope, I didn't.
My stomach has gotten smaller lately.
My 'pig power' is going to become boring before it even gets started.
Based on your last live, it didn't seem that way.
That was my first meal.
It wasn't a whole giant pizza~
It was just six slices.
Six huge slices?!
Changing my image isn't easy.
Six slices the size of my torso.
Happy now???!!!!!
Legeeend~~~
You're seriously getting on my nerves. ㅋㅋ
ㄹㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
I want to make a joke, but I don't know how. It's frustrating.
Did you inherit your desire to make jokes from me?
Why does everyone keep saying they don't know what joke to make? ㄹㄹㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
Teach me how to be funny.
That's the realm of talent.
You can improve with effort, though.
Triggered?
ㅎㅎㄹㅎ
Triggered? Triggered?
You crying?
Hey, are you crying?
Triggered??
Seriously, I'm fine. Stop talking to me.
Myael-gyael-jae-myael-rae-gae~~
Hey, let go. I said let go.
Nwae-bwae-rae-gae~~
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋ
Is 'jinjinjin' not trendy anymore?
I don't really use it these days.
But the members and staff keep using it.
They even tell me how it went after using it on their friends. 😂
So I'm thinking of bringing 'jinjinjin' back.
ㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹ

messages.ko: 아니 억지 유행 밀어붙히는 줄 알았는데 유행을 하네..
messages.en: I thought you were forcing it to become a trend, but it actually caught on...
Everything is about momentum.
The people who said it was too childish are the ones using it the most now.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ

messages.ko: 나 원래 피자 꼬다리 잘 안먹으려고 하는데
messages.en: I usually don't eat pizza crusts.
But this one is like chewy bread.
It's so delicious!!!!! 😍😍😍😍
My friend said it's like a pizza crust made from butter rice cake baked three times.
Here's my honest opinion.
Butter rice cake still isn't enough to beat Dubai chewy cookies.
Just eat a madeleine.
Or eat rice cakes.
Have you tried Chang-eok rice cakes? I heard they're trending.
Seoyeon unnie gave them to the members once.
But I misheard it as 'chang-eo tteok' (eel rice cake).
I thought it was some kind of fish rice cake.
I was like, 'How does something like that become a trend?'
But...
I was completely wrong.
What if you started your own food trend?
To make something trend these days,
you'd probably have to mix all kinds of random things together.
Dubai chewy butter rice cake.
Honestly, I think that'll come out within a month.
Anyway,
I have so many things I want to tell you that my mouth is itching.
I'll just scratch at it and hold myself back.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋ
Look forward to it~
I'm going to finish eating and then go to sleep.
Sleep well in advance.
Haranghae ❤️‍🔥❤️‍🔥
